title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Auditorium on 1973-02-17
lineage: DAT/0 (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC
source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent sound‑board capture of a high‑energy early‑73 show highlighted by the smoking Here Comes Sunshine → China Cat → Rider segue and blistering solos.
ai_review.review: The three‑hour, 29‑song performance is praised as one of the strongest from early ’73, with standout moments like HCS > China Cat > Rider, a hot Playing in the Band solo, and soaring vocals throughout. The soundboard source is generally crisp and clear, though a few listeners note occasional bumps and vocal isolation on certain tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings (5‑star) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the soundboard quality, offset only by a single negative note about occasional bumps.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall crisp and balanced mix with clear instrument separation; some listeners mention occasional bumpy sections and overly isolated vocal tracks on specific songs.

standout_songs: Here Comes Sunshine > China Cat Sunflower > Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight three‑hour marathon with seamless segues (notably HCS → China Cat → Rider) and strong transitions that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for hot, deft solos on Playing in the Band and overall shredding throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a solid, bouncing bass foundation and standout moments like his intro on Box of Rain.
band_member_comments.Bob: Shines on vocal duties (especially on Little Light/LLR) and provides strong counterpoint to Jerry's guitar.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith delivers subtle flourishes throughout, with a notable solo during Big River and supportive backing on the HCS segue.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's solid backbeat is highlighted as providing a reliable rhythmic foundation.
